item.title: President Trump Awarded FIFA Peace Prize At World Cup Draw
item.description: US President Donald Trump: US President Donald Trump on Friday was presented with the inaugural 2025 FIFA Peace Prize during the World Cup draw ceremony in the American capital, where football's global governing body credited him with advancing a series of high-profile peace agreements and "exceptional and extraordinary actions to promote peace and unity around the world."

item.title: Odisha: Security Heightened Ahead Of India-Africa T20 At Barabati Stadium
item.description: Cuttack Police Commissioner Suresh Dev: Bhubaneswar-Cuttack Police Commissioner Suresh Dev Datta Singh on Monday said that comprehensive security arrangements have been put in place for the upcoming India-South Africa T20 match scheduled to be held at Barabati Stadium on December 9.

item.title: FIFA Awards First-ever Peace Prize To US President Donald Trump Ahead Of World Cup Draw
item.description: US President Donald Trump: FIFA, the global governing body for international football, on Friday named American President Donald Trump as the first winner of the newly-created FIFA Peace Prize, during the draw ceremony for next year's FIFA Men's World Cup to be jointly hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

item.title: I Began Playing Cricket Because Of My Brother, Says Deepti Sharma
item.description: Deepti Sharma: All-rounder Deepti Sharma opened up about the moment that changed her life, the person who first saw her potential and encouraged her to take up cricket - her elder brother.

item.title: Mexico To Face South Korea At Home As FIFA Unveil 2026 Wirld Cup Draw
item.description: The draw for the 2026 FIFA World Cup was conducted on Friday at John F. Kennedy Center, setting the stage for the first 48-team edition of football's biggest tournament.

item.title: Rohit's Aggressive Approach Changed How India Plays White-ball Cricket, Says Abhishek Nayar
item.description: On Virat Kohli: Former India cricketer Abhishek Nayar heaped praise on batter Rohit Sharma, crediting his aggressive approach for the change in the way of playing ODI format.

item.title: Olympic Torch Relay Celebration Cauldron For Milan-Cortina 2026 Lit In Italy
item.description: International Olympic Committee President Kirsty: Italian President Sergio Mattarella lit the torch relay celebration cauldron for the 2026 Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics on Friday in the heart of the country's capital, Rome.

item.title: Epic 202 by Greaves Rescues West Indies in Christchurch Thriller
item.description: Justin Greaves’ unbeaten 202 and Kemar Roach’s gritty 58* helped West Indies pull off a valiant draw against New Zealand in the first Test at Christchurch. Chasing 531, the visitors finished on 457-6—the second-highest fourth-innings total in Test history.

item.title: Scaloni Urges Focus As Argentina Draw ‘favourable’ Group For 2026 Title Defence
item.description: Lionel Scaloni: Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni insisted his team will stick to the principles that carried them to glory at Qatar 2022 as the world champions assessed their opponents for next year’s global tournament. Drawn into Group J alongside Algeria, Austria and debutants Jordan, the Albiceleste were widely seen back home as having received a favourable path — though Scaloni was quick to stress that nothing would be taken lightly.

item.title: Justin Greaves' Unbeaten 202 Lead West Indies To Epic Draw In Christchurch
item.description: Justin Greaves: A mammoth effort from Justin Greaves, 202 not, and an unbeaten 58 from Kemar Roach helped West Indies pull off an epic draw against New Zealand in the first Test at Hagley Oval. Earlier, the West Indies created history, achieving the highest fourth-innings score in Test cricket on Saturday.
